newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil weak - buying relaxed, squeeze fears.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil weak - buying relaxed, squeeze fears.

text.p: NWE gas oil prices and differentials to IPE futures came under further pressure on Tuesday with a steep futures backwardation fuelling fears of a squeeze but good avails keeping buyers relaxed, traders said.
Fears of yet another squeeze of front-month IPE gas oil futures pushed the Feb/March Spread out to around $10 leaving few players willing to pay Feb related numbers.
Premiums for prompt barges and cargoes sank to around IPE screen evens with around 14 Russian cargoes scheduled to load at Ventspils by Feb 11 and cargoes also expected from the Med.

The only form of support came from the U.S. trade house who is thought to be running a long futures position that is boosting the Feb/March spread. The trader is also expected to take a large delivery from the Feb IPE contract when it expires on Feb 12 and was seen showing active buying interest for the lower priced Russian cargoes today, traders said.

They said the steep screen backwardation to March -- supported by a U.S. trading house's long position -- was keeping other buyers out of the market preferring to talk March IPE related numbers for all but very prompt requirements.
"Cargoes are coming from Russia, from the Med and refiners are also looking for buyers," one broker said.
